title: Ectopic KRT5+ pod area over damaged alveolar area
rationale: The engine is marker-wise: positiveAreaInRoi() takes ONE marker's mask, and
every recomputed fraction divides by region_area_um2. It therefore cannot
express a numerator that is a RELATION between two markers, which is what
Lin et al. J Clin Invest 2024;134(19):e176828 Fig 2A-B quantify
'KRT5+PDPN- areas', not bare KRT5+ area. The co-negativity is what rejects
autofluorescence: autofluorescent structures are bright in EVERY channel,
genuine dysplastic pods are KRT5-bright and PDPN-negative.
This spec declares the relation as DATA so it is reviewable and diffable,
and evaluates it downstream by mask algebra on the masks the engine already

terms.note: KRT5+ area after the engine's 50 um2 component filter

note: The region ROI is supplied by Stage 1. When it partitions parenchyma,
the damaged region's area IS the denominator, so no second denominator
is needed here. Do NOT use AGER- as a per-pixel numerator constraint:
'intact' is DEFINED by AGER density, so that is circular. See

in sum_cols and recomputes KRT5ectopic_pod_area_frac against pooled
region_area_um2. A name outside that whitelist is SILENTLY DROPPED at

krt5_threshold.note: Must be frozen from blinded controls before any batch run.

note: Co-negativity ceiling. Derived control-only by a two-sided rule:
maximise specificity subject to preserving >=90% of genuine airway
KRT5. Enrichment ratio R = 0.55-0.62 at this value.
OUTSTANDING: measured at 2.76 um/px; must be re-measured at full
tile resolution (0.345 um/px) where partial-volume mixing at
pod/AT1 boundaries is worst. m6's positive control is a handful of
pixels, so this rests on m4-2 alone.

known_limitations: Conducting airways are excluded from neither numerator nor denominator.
Airway basal cells are KRT5+ in every animal including uninfected controls.
Nothing in the 4-channel panel separates airway from injured alveolus.
Five parameters are now derived from two control animals.
The reference method measured these areas BY HAND (Axiovision outline
spline), so validation against manual outlines is still required.

reference.citation: Lin X. et al., J Clin Invest 2024;134(19):e176828
